requests.prompt:
Create exactly ONE uninterrupted full-frame vertical 9:16 production illustration in detailed cinematic ChronoStick. Input image 1 is master rendering authority only; never copy its board layout. All surfaces are drawn with dark controlled outlines and simplified matte forms, muted ochre/umber/slate/burgundy/olive palette and soft cinematic illustrated shading. People have round off-white heads, dot eyes, very sparse brows/mouth, no realistic nose, narrow stick-derived bodies/limbs and simple pale drawn hands; detailed clothing follows that simplified skeleton, not human anatomical bodies. Standard full body about 5.0–5.8 head diameters, shoulders narrower than a head. No photorealistic inserts or painterly surface rendering. One scene, one viewpoint, one instant; exact inventory stated below. No grid, panels, border, repeated views, inset faces, typography, captions, labels, readable letters or numerals. All story-critical subjects/props within safe margins. Zero unlisted people, animals, vehicles, signs, flags, weapons or props.

Input 2 controls Fawkes, input 3 controls unnamed burgundy flat-cap conspirator A, input 4 controls unnamed olive bareheaded conspirator B. Exactly THREE adult stick people around ONE square dark oak table in an intimate 1605 room: Fawkes centered behind the table, A screen left turned inward, B screen right turned inward. Preserve each supplied face silhouette, hair/beard, headwear, costume colors and narrow anatomy. Fawkes keeps plain broad dark felt hat, dark wavy hair, moustache and pointed beard, pale open collar, charcoal doublet and umber cloak; he is a participant, not presented as sole mastermind. A retains wine-red flat cap, clean-shaven face, burgundy jerkin/cream sleeves and exactly one small wooden cross pendant openly visible at upper chest. B has short auburn hair, NO hat, NO beard, olive short doublet. A's ONE primary pointing hand rests beside an unlettered small outline sketch of the medieval two-gabled Parliament on ONE pale plan sheet laid flat on the table. Exactly ONE small simple brass crown-shaped miniature sits near the sheet's lower-left edge as a symbolic king-target prop; not a portrait or authentic historical document. Fawkes's two simple hands brace the far table edge; B's two hands rest near right edge. One room/instant, no pointing duplicates. Eye-level medium framing, heads and table fully inside safe crop; visible pendant, miniature crown, plan and Fawkes face large enough for crop inserts. Plain drawn timber/plaster walls and one high dark window, soft amber left key and cool shadow right. No writing on the plan, no barrels, weapons, lanterns, modern mask, extra figures or furniture.
